text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 黑色银圆扣细腰带。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Edit this exact isolated product photo. Remove all decorative dangling metal chains and chain loops from the product. Preserve its body, original leather/fabric handles, strap, buckles, rings, zipper pulls and studs. Do not alter necklaces because this is not a necklace. Pure white background. Keep other details unchanged. No new items.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
